Activist Investors Push Companies to Explore Sale Options

Activist investors have sent letters to two companies, Devon Energy and an unnamed construction company, urging them to explore strategic alternatives, including a potential sale. Toms Capital sent a letter to Devon Energy, while Starboard Value sent one to the construction firm. The specific details of the construction company's situation were not provided in the coverage.
